chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Slays Two of the Six Excellences in Chang'an Night Battle
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen kills Ye Tian and Xia Ding in a brutal confrontation, shattering the Six Excellences' invincible legend with his martial body and Reverse Dragon Seven Steps.
og_title: Chang'an Night Battle: Two of the Six Excellences Fall to Xiao Chen
og_description: Xiao Chen demonstrates unstoppable power as he crushes the Six Excellences, absorbing the Indestructible Imperial Heavenly Bell and destroying the nine bronze tripods.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Dominates: Two Six Excellences Killed
twitter_description: In a night of epic combat, Xiao Chen slays two of the Six Excellences, cementing his status as the most feared young expert on the Eternal Continent.
